notlar: Residual axes are the additive main-effect residuals of experiments/q1_ek_gradyan_kosinus.py (ek on kayit 6.2), recomputed here with GA.ana_etki_artik.
Spearman r and the pair count n are printed in every card; the p floor (6/6 at the floor, foy 1977) is not printed.
kararlar: Karar: the Rank correlation summary card is removed (plan section 6, M5), because its six values are printed in the panels; the scatter columns grow to about 53.6 mm.
Karar: pair types use the paper palette family cift_turu (black, yellow with black edge, grey), because #0072B2 and #D55E00 encode R224 and ViT-Tiny elsewhere (plan 4.3, m9).

Karar: mixed pairs are drawn as open grey squares and layered yellow, grey, black from the back, because denge.py's shadow test read a filled grey square under an overlapping black or yellow mark as a drop shadow (a data overlap, not a shadow); an open mark is a white copy, which the test does not count, and the hue still binds the palette's mixed entry.

Karar (duzeltme turu 2): the y labels read 'log τ̄' and 'log τ̄ residual', because the plotted matrix is the symmetric log_tau_matrisi (max |T - T^T| = 0), which the text and the council figure write as log τ̄_ij.
Karar: the row strip is a narrow white card with rotated row names, because every text must stand inside a card (millimetre controller).
